storage: Airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place; very old chickpeas take much longer to soften. Soaked chickpeas keep in the fridge for a day; boiled chana freezes for about 3 months.
looksLike: Large, round, beige-cream peas with a small beak-like tip; they swell to about double when soaked.
howToPick: Uniform, plump, pale-cream peas of similar size; avoid shrivelled, dark, broken or insect-holed ones and a musty smell. Larger grades cost more but cook the same.
shelfLife: About 12 months in a sealed container (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Canned or ready-boiled chickpeas (about 125 g drained for 50 g dry)
White rajma or white peas (safed vatana)

usedIn.raw: 50 g dry per serving (about 120 g once boiled)
